grades: Not stated on the pages read
name: California FBLA (Future Business Leaders of America)
city: California (through school chapters in six geographic sections)
what_you_do: Join a school business club. It has contests, leadership training and conferences. These include section and state conferences. There is also a national conference.
who_can_apply: Students at a California school with an FBLA chapter. The FAQ says FBLA is open to students enrolled in a Career and Technical Education (CTE) business program.
pay_detail: Not a job. The join page lists no dues amounts.
deadline_text: No join deadline on the page.
how_to_apply: Ask whether your school has a chapter: email hello@cafbla.org or call (714) 824-4489. If not, fill out the FBLA Interest Form so staff can help your school affiliate; that needs your school administration.
notes: You join through a school chapter, so you need a business pathway or class at your school. If your school has no business program, the FAQ says starting one has to be started with school administration.
